title: Great game BUT…….
body:
It’s a great game, but I think the team tracking system needs to be adjusted.

When teams in the Death Bracket are consistently playing the other top teams, everyone should receive Gold Cards. Every match is against elite competition, and those teams are constantly battling each other. It doesn’t make sense to reward some while penalizing others simply because they’re all facing the toughest opponents available.

The current system ends up hurting the most competitive teams. Over time, it becomes a team killer. Players get frustrated when their effort isn’t properly rewarded, which leads to people leaving teams or even quitting the game altogether.

Reward the difficulty of the competition, not just the outcome. That would make the system feel much fairer and help keep the game’s best players engaged.

title: Used to be great. Now you have to pay to win

This used to be one of my favorite and only downtime mobile baseball games. It was fun because skill, strategy, and smart upgrades actually mattered. Lately, though, it feels like the game has become heavily pay-to-win.

If you don’t spend money on premium bats, uniforms, and player upgrades, you’re at a huge disadvantage. Matchmaking often feels stacked against free-to-play players, and progression has become more about your wallet than your ability.

I don’t mind games offering cosmetic purchases or optional boosts, but when paying becomes the deciding factor in who wins, the competitive aspect disappears. It’s disappointing because the gameplay itself is still great. I hope the developers bring the balance back and reward skill instead of spending.

title: MONEY GRAB / PAY TO WIN
body: Read all the other reviews about how this is a money grab game if you want to win or even compete in the higher ranks. There is absolutely no skill involved in this game. Players who pay to upgrade their players will ALWAYS hit better, field better, play better and win… even if you have a 4 or 5 run lead on them. They ALWAYS come back and win because your players that have not been upgraded via payment plan will make errors, or your pitcher will not pitch in the strike zone, or the other team players will smack home runs when you clearly pitch WAY OUT OF THE STRIKE ZONE. It’s a scam and money grabbing game that is no longer fun and entertaining.

title: Game is absolutely horrible - Lots of issues
body:
There is so many de-sync issues, where ur lagging because of someone else and they get free bases or pitches. Or you will flat out be one of their players to the base and they just get the safe because of the lag.

There is also lots of unrealistic hits, hits that look like they should be line drives get hit like bunts. Pitches that should never be hit for a homer like opposite side of the strike zone up and away get hit over the fence, but pitches right down the middle with perfect timing are ground outs.

Every pitch is lucky, there isn’t too much skill. It’s just about who has more luck in that given situation

title: Predetermined
body: IMO this game is predetermined. I see it far too often to believe it’s unintentional. So I score a run today. The player just stands on home plate after scoring. The throw was off-line and it went to the backstop. The opponent gets it, runs over to me, tagged me and somehow I’m out. Things like this aren’t rare. So I know the game was fixed. That’s how it goes. I just played a game where the ball clearly rolled over 3rd base (they showed it in slow motion) and it was called a foul.
